question: Which one of the following sentences correctly describes the properties of water? It:
options: allows all light wavelengths to pass through its various depths.
requires high amount of energy to heat up.
contracts when it freezes and hence acts as an insulator.
takes low energy to change into vapor.
explanation:
Water has a very high specific heat capacity. This means it requires a high amount of energy to heat up (or change its temperature).

 The high specific heat helps moderate temperatures on Earth.
